bank_name: National Credit and Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: Half-Yearly unaudited report used as the project's Q2 data point. Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention established from the filing's own column header 'January 01 to June 30, 2012'. Standalone/Solo basis. Source PDF (half_yearly_report_2012.pdf) is a native digital PDF with a clean pdftotext -layout extraction; figures cross-verified: balance sheet ties to the taka (Total Liabilities 98,149,989,920 + Total Equity 11,222,817,635 = Total Assets 109,372,807,555); Profit before tax 958,982,635 - Provision for tax 502,150,774 = Profit after tax 456,831,861, matching the filing's own EPS of 0.66. Cross-check: comparative 'December 31, 2011' column (Total Assets BDT 103,510.70mn, Total Equity BDT 11,583.80mn) matches the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2011_Q4.json exactly. DISCREPANCY FOUND: this filing's own comparative 'January 01 to June 30, 2011' P&L column shows Interest paid on deposits and borrowings of BDT 3,490,515,414 (Net interest income BDT 982,492,007), matching the 2011_Q2.json record exactly -- however, the LATER 2013_Q2 (H1 2013) filing's comparative column for the same period (H1 2012, not H1 2011) shows a different Interest paid figure for THIS period (H1 2012) of BDT 4,624,490,484 versus BDT 4,749,412,035 reported contemporaneously here, i.e. the H1 2013 filing shows a restated (lower) interest expense / higher Net Interest Income (BDT 1,018,369,494 vs BDT 893,447,943) for H1 2012. Per project convention, this file's contemporaneous figures are retained as authoritative; the divergence is also noted in the 2013_Q2.json record.
